turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.

I can’t file the return because the order hasn’t been delivered yet. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery; you pay the return postage, and staff must approve the refund. If you’d like, contact us again after delivery.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: The parcel has not reached me yet. I changed my mind.
I can’t cancel the order because production has already started. Staff must approve any refund.

rule.ro: O comandă se poate anula cât timp este plătită și producția nu a început. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: An order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Also, can you help me fill in my tax return for last year? It has nothing to do with the shop, but I am stuck on the form.
Sorry, I can’t help with tax returns or other matters unrelated to the shop.
Back to the order. Please file the shop return. I am not threatening anyone.

I can’t file the return yet because the parcel hasn’t been delivered. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery; you pay the return postage, and staff must approve the refund. Please contact us again after delivery if you still want to return it.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
